title: A send queue waits and tries the same customer again after an unexpected error or a Gmail token refusal, and pauses only after the retry window
steps: S1: From the checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/invitations-real-send.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of the test named in run.tests.
expect: Gmail token endpoint answering 503: two cron passes pause nothing, the queue stays running with 3 pending; when the token is back the same customer is sent once, its send rows are failed, failed, sent.
A database query failing inside a pass: the queue stays running, nothing sent or skipped; past AMEMBER_RETRY_MS the next failing pass pauses it with REAL_INTERNAL.
On the code before PR 671 the named test is 'not ok'.
evidence: 16/11/2026: the Black Friday renewal queue paused at 13:23 on REAL_INTERNAL with the mailbox connected and lay still for 20 hours; Resume worked at once. 05/11/2026: a queue paused on MAILBOX_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE the same way.
fence: Retries never double-send: an unexpected error replays the same request key, a token refusal is recorded failed before anything leaves and the next try uses a new key.

tests: send queue: an unexpected error and a Gmail token refusal wait and try the same customer again inside the retry window, then pause
